name: Kinetic Canvas & Acoustic Art
description: Abstract generative art and kinetic split-flap acoustic soundscapes for Vestaboard Note and Flagship.
author: Sneakamaila

mode.title: Art & Sound Mode
mode.description: Select the generative art style and acoustic sound profile.

display_layout.title: Board Layout Preset
display_layout.description: Choose whether the board shows pure full-screen art or includes title & sound telemetry.
enumNames: Art Canvas with Sound Badge (Art + Title & Acoustic Waveform)

chime_style.title: Zen Chime Sound Profile
chime_style.description: Specific acoustic sound envelope when Zen Chime mode is active.

wolfram_rule.title: Wolfram Rule Number
wolfram_rule.description: Cellular rule for Wolfram tapestries (30 = chaotic, 90 = Sierpinski, 110 = complex).

city_name.title: Weather Location (City Name)
city_name.description: Display name of your location for weather resonance.

latitude.title: Weather Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude coordinate for Open-Meteo weather API (e.g. 52.52)

longitude.title: Weather Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude coordinate for Open-Meteo weather API (e.g. 13.405)

demo_mode.title: Weather Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Simulate atmospheric weather data without internet requests.

quiet_hours_enabled.title: Enable Quiet Hours (Nachtruhe)
quiet_hours_enabled.description: Silence or dampen acoustic flap movements during nighttime hours.

quiet_hours_start.title: Quiet Hours Start (HH:MM)
quiet_hours_start.description: Start time for night silence (24h format, e.g. 22:00).

quiet_hours_end.title: Quiet Hours End (HH:MM)
quiet_hours_end.description: End time for night silence (24h format, e.g. 07:00).

quiet_mode_behavior.title: Quiet Mode Behavior
quiet_mode_behavior.description: Action when quiet hours are active.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: Interval between kinetic transitions (minimum 30 seconds to preserve hardware).

title.description: Poetic title of the current artwork composition
title.example: Composition #402 in Rot, Gelb und Blau

description.description: Detailed description of the visual piece or current simulation state

is_quiet_hours.description: Whether quiet hours are currently suppressing sound (YES or NO)

sound_profile.description: Acoustic intensity category (Silent, Whisper, Rainfall, Crescendo, Thunder)

total_clicks.description: Total mechanical flap clicks generated in this transition

moving_modules.description: Count of physical modules that rotated during this transition

duration_sec.description: Estimated acoustic duration of the mechanical transition

acoustic_sparkline.description: ASCII sparkline of acoustic activity across board columns
